title: Shivam v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi, J.; Ajit Singh, J.
disposition: Writ disposed without merits; Executive Engineer directed to look into and redress the pending 15 HP connection grievance within two weeks.
headnote: A consumer sought mandamus for a pending 15 HP new connection for a Ganna Perai Power Kolhu. The Division Bench treated the Electricity Act, 2003 and the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as a self-contained regime, expressed no opinion on merits, and with the parties’ consent disposed of the writ by directing the Executive Engineer, PVVNL Division-1, Dhampur, to look into the grievance and redress it within two weeks of production of a certified copy.
facts: Shivam, a resident of Village Davkhedi, District Bijnor, applied online on 15 November 2022 to the Executive Engineer, Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited, Division-1, Dhampur, for a 15 HP connection to operate a Ganna Perai Power Kolhu on Khasra Plot Nos. 84 and 71 of Village Talampur Kumrara, Tehsil Dhampur. He paid an online application fee of Rs. 118. The application remained pending and no connection was released. He sought a mandamus commanding the licensee to provide the 15 HP supply.

holding_units.topic: pending new connection — writ disposed for time-bound administrative redress
holding_units.holding: Where an online application for a new 15 HP connection remains pending with the distribution licensee, the High Court will not decide entitlement in writ jurisdiction. Treating the Electricity Act, 2003 and the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as a self-contained regime, and with the parties’ consent, the writ is disposed of without opinion on merits and the Executive Engineer is directed to look into the grievance and redress it within two weeks of production of a certified copy.
holding_units.flag: Order cites the Electricity Act, 2003 and the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 generally; no numbered clause.

principle_tags.application: The 15 HP Ganna Perai Kolhu application of 15.11.2022 was still pending; the Bench refused a merits mandamus and directed the EE, PVVNL Division-1, Dhampur, to look into and redress the grievance within two weeks.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner was entitled on merits to the 15 HP connection for the Ganna Perai Power Kolhu
not_decided.note: Court expressly declined any opinion on the merits of the issue.
